result.brief: 提出 AnchorDLM：用强化学习训练的锚点生成器为扩散语言模型产生内容与位置可控的控制 token，并以离散流匹配视角解释其对初始速度场的重塑，提升可控性与推理表现。
result.reason: Proposes anchor control tokens for diffusion language models, interpreting placement via discrete flow matching; directly addresses continuous/diffusion language modeling and latent control.
